notes: VAT standard rate 15% (VAT Act 2010 s.6 and Fourth Schedule; SRC brochure). Bullion coded 15: the complete Act text was searched - the words gold and precious appear nowhere, including the First Schedule (exempt) and Second Schedule (zero-rated). Import duty 0%: the Customs Management (Tariff) Regulations 2022 rate all HS 7108 lines 0% in every column. Silver duty not separately verified - null.

sources.name: Value Added Tax Act 2010 (SeyLII official law report) and Seychelles Revenue Commission VAT brochure
sources.what: Read 2026-11-28: the rate of VAT for the purposes of section 6 is 15%; the Act contains no gold or precious-metals provision
sources.quote: The rate of VAT for the purposes of section 6 is 15%.
